verdict.rationale: Intel Gaudi 3 is a datacenter AI training and inference accelerator. The evidence covers PyTorch, DeepSpeed, vLLM, OAM/PCIe server form factors and Ethernet fabrics, so it is not a consumer graphics card. Gaming upscaling and frame generation (DLSS/FSR) are a category error for this product type, and nothing in the evidence suggests it ships any such gaming capability.
